translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Sessoaton Jesus
Enoa sefaaeneto Jesus me reen pwupwu we Jordan nge a sseog noa reen Espritu Santus iwe nge Espritu Santus a paeninoa noan desert,
nge Saetan a noa soatoni me ee noan faaeig raaen. Noan oanongaen raaenin kkewe nge ese mwongo, ina miniwe a meyaefi pecchai reen.
Saetan a aengaeni pwe, “Ngaere een Naiun Deus, wopwe aengaeniir faai kaan pwe repwe ssiuwen ngaeni fenoawa.”
Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Pwapwior we e Santus e aepesa pwe, ‘Saapw fenoawa rhag minne aeremas repwe menaw reen.’ ”
Iwe Saetan a pwigitae weei naaeng nge a noa pwaeri ngaeni reen rhag eew oat oanongaen mweoi me noan faeinaengiy.
Saetan a aengaeni pwe, “Ipwe ngaenneog oanongaen mamaaw kkeei me oanongaen mmwen kkeei. Oanongaen nge nemaeniaei, nge ipwe fang ngaeni iyo iye tipaei ipwe ngaenneei.
Oanongaen minikkeei nge epwe no pwe oamw igine wopwe oassotupw ngaeniaei.”
Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Pwapwior we e Santus e aepesa pwe, ‘Wopwe oassotupw ngaeni Deus na oamw Soamwoon nge iiy rhag wopwe engaang ngaeni. ’”
Iwe Saetan a pwigi noa Jerusalem nge a noa iseni tae pwiuneoi we oarosaen taegias me reen Temple we, nge a aengaeni pwe, “Ngaere een Naiun Deus nge wa oatoroagotiw me igeei.
Pwe iwe Pwapwior we e Santus e aepesa pwe, ‘Deus epwe akkiuneeor naiun angkenus repwe aemmwenoag.’
Nge epwan aepesa pwe, ‘Repwe ammwarhiug tae noan paiiur pwe pirhemw mwo nge ete woas ngaeni faai.’ ”
Iwe nge Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Pwapwior we e Santus e aepesa pwe, ‘Wosoapw soatoni Deus na oamw Soamwoon.’ ”
Weni mwirin aaen Saetan soatoni Jesus, iwe nge a nigiti noa mwo.
Jesus a Rhaepeta Aan Engaang me Noan Galilee
Iwe Jesus a sefaaen ngaeni Galilee, iwe nge miniwe maemaewaen Espritu Santus eno reen. Miniwe fioangon a rheeoi fetaen wooan oanongan noa faniuw we.
A fenai fetaen noan wutteer Jews nge oanongaen aeremas ra mwaar reen.
Rhooan Nazareth Rese Aetiwa Jesus
Jesus a noa Nazareth, igiwe effooan me ee, nge wooan Sabbath a noa noan wutteer Jews we taeppen rhag miniwe egaen feeori. A iutae pwe epwene aeraegi Pwapwior we e Santus,
nge ra ngaenneei pwapwior we aaen profeta Isaiah. A suginoa pwapwior we nge a weri pwiuneoi we effoat me ee,

content.text: pwe iya ffin tae ipwe pwigito Kkepas Mwamwaai eei reer rhooa affayeo.
Iya fangenoa ngaang ipwe oaronga ngaeniir rhooan kanepwus pwe iir ra saenetaeg
nge i aecchipwaar rhooa parh pwe repwe ffat noa,
me pwan aengesaar noa rhooa waeiraes
iwe me ipwe oaronga ngaeniir aeremas pwe a toori oatowe Soamwoon epwe aemenewaar naiun aeremas.”

content: Jesus a oawunnu noa pwapwior we, a ateeow sefaaeniy ngaeni aeremas we e tipaengi, iwe nge a mooat tiw. Oanongeer aeremas kkewe noan wutteer Jews we nge a meseer ngaeni rhag,
Iwe nge a aengaeniir pwe, “Soapwon kkepas e noan Pwapwior we e Santus iye igina nge a pwae noa pwe ennet, iye oawwa rongorong ngaeni.”
Ra piungiun mwaar reen nge ra maengi noannei nong mwamwaaiun ititin aan kkepas. Ra iura pwe, “Saapw iiy mwaaen we naiun Joseph?”

A aengaeniir pwe, “I giuneei firhiy pwe oawpwe aengaeni sefaaeniaei kkepas een, ‘Toagota, aecchipwa oanongoamw.’ Oawpwe akkiuneowaei pwe ipwe feeori me nee pwugusaei minikkewe oaw rongorong pwe i fasiun gaen feeori me noan Capernaum.”
Jesus a iura pwe, “Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi, pwe profeta nge ese gacch aar aewenimmwaar me noan pwuguseer.

Aiussaening ngaeniaei: regin towunap rhooapwut kka ra mae rhooan ngaenneyeer me wooan Israel noan oatowe oaton Elijah, oatowe esooar worhow noan enuuw me esoapw raeg iwe a itto eew naengeta gin oarosaen temoag wooan oanongaen faniuw we.
Inamwo nge esooar erhai ne re fangenoa Elijah reen me wooan Israel, pwe aeggaen erhai rhag rhooapwut a mae rhooan ngaenneyan eno wooan Zarephath me wooan faniuw na Sidon.
Iwe nge ra gin ssow rhooa affayeo reen kaenepaai kka reno wooan Israel reen oatowe oaton Elisha; nge inamwo nge erhai mwo me neeiir nge ese cchipw, pwe aeggaen Naaman we erhai re Syria.”
Igiwe aeremas kkewe reno noan wutteer Jews we ra rongorong miniwe nge a gin teeo ngaeniir aar soong.
Ra iutae rhag, iuriutepa wow Jesus me noan aepinoamw we, nge ra pwigitae wooan wungaen rhug we eno miniwe aepinoamwoor wooan. Re menaen pwe repwe aerheei noa me wooan rhug we,
iwe nge iiy etowow rhag me nugunupaen pwuwa we nge a faaeraeg noa.
Mwaaen we Eyor Aniu Aenneew Wooan
Iwe Jesus a noa wooan Capernaum, eew aepinoamwon Galilee, a noa fenai ngaeniir aeremas wooan Sabbath.
Ra mwaar reen aan fenai, pwe igiwe eyor kkemenaen aan fenai.
Noan wutteer Jews we nge eyor erhai mwaaen eyor aniu aenneew wooan; a gin aekkepwas temoag tae,
“Ah! Meeta oamw mwerhaen ngaenigemaem, Jesus re Nazareth? Wa itto igeei pwe wopwe oatoaropagemaem? Ngaang i giuneei een iyo: een mwaaenessoar we rhooan pweipwogin kkepas we aaen Deus!”

Jesus a anniugiu ngaeni aniuwe pwe, “Wopwe anniug noa nge wa siunoa me wooan mwaaen na!” Iwe nge aniu aenneew we a aerheei tiw mwaaen we weni mmweer rhooawe nge a teeowow me wooan, nge esooar minne e oawoasu ngaeni.
Aeremas ra piungiun mwaar nge ra kkepas fengaen wooar pwe, “Meeta taeppen kkepas kkeei? Eyor kkemenaen me maemaewaen aaen mwaaen een kkepas ngaeniir aniu aenneew nge ra siu!”
Iwe miniwe fioangon Jesus a rheeoi fetaen wooan faniuw we.
Jesus a Aecchipwa Towunepaen Aeremas
Jesus a siusaengi wutteer Jews we iwe a noa reen miniwe pwugusaen Simon. Niewe inaen pwiuniuwaen Simon e semwaai pwe egin pwerhikkar ginin, iwe ra kkepas ngaeni Jesus reen mmwenen.

A noa iwe a noa iu oaron niewe iwe nge a aengaeni pwerhikkar we pwe epwe siusaengi niewe. Iwe rhag nge esaer noa miniwe pwerhin niewe, iwe niewe a rhimwitae pwe a ittae feor fetaen minne epwe tipaengi ngaeniir.
Enoa mwirin tupwunoan aenet nge oanongeer rhooawe eyor rhooa semwaai reer nge ra pwigiir to reen Jesus. E iseni tae paiun wooar oanongeer nge a aecchipwaar tae.

Mwuniaan mwo nge re piungiun teeowow me wooar rhooa towunap we nge ra itiwow aekkepwas pwe, “Een mwaaen we Naiun Deus!” Jesus a kkepas sseor ngaeniir aniu aenneew kkewe pwe resoapw kkepas, pwe igiwe re giuneei pwe iiy miniwe Kristus.
Jesus e Fenai Noan Wutteer Jews Kkewe

Weni mmwaei raaen Jesus a nigiti aepinoamw we iwe a noa eew pwiuneoi ne iiy noa rhag. Aeremas a rhaepetae aar giutta fetaeneei, iwe nge renoa weri, nge ra aegina aar ammwarhiu tiw pwe ete rhiuwen siunoa.
Iwe nge iya aengaeniir pwe, “Ngaang ipwan noa fenaiuw Kkepas Mwamwaai we reen Mweoiun Deus me noan aepinoamw kena aekkaew, pwe ina minne Deus efang ngaang pwe ipwe noa feeori.”
Iwe a noa fenaiuw noan oanongan noa wutteer Jews me wooan faniuw we.
